# Curry

## Roles

Tenure Track Faculty

## Biography

Dr. Shannon Curry is an Associate Professor in the Astrophysics and Planetary Sciences (APS) Department at the University of Colorado, Boulder and is currently the Principal Investigator of the NASA Mars Atmosphere and Volatile EvolutioN (MAVEN) mission. Prior to this, she served as the Assistant Deputy Director of Planetary Science at the Space Sciences Laboratory at the University of California, Berkeley. Her research focus is on the evolution of planetary atmospheres with respect to the sun’s radiation environment, solar wind and solar activity. She is also involved in mission concepts, mission design and instrument development for future flight missions to other bodies in the solar system. She is currently a science team member on NASA’s Parker Solar Probe (PSP) mission, Project Scientist for NASA’s ESCAPADE mission (phase D), and a collaborator on NASA’s Nexus for Exoplanet System Science (NExSS) program. She also serves on NASA’s Planetary Advisory Committee (PAC).

# **Grant Operations Management**

# **NASA Grant Operations Management**

Regulations, Guidance, & Forms

Resources and Training

Points of Contact

Frequently Asked Questions

Important Links

The Office of Procurement, Grant Operations Management (GOM) assesses and interprets Federal financial assistance statutes, regulations, and policies issued by governing and oversight bodies to determine how best to implement  guidance that aligns to the grant life cycle and takes into account NASA’s unique structure, resources, and requirements. NASA grant guidance is developed to operationalize requirements stemming from key external stakeholders, such as the Office of Management and Budget (OMB), while aligning guidance to the priorities, requirements, and objectives of NASA’s programmatic and operational organizations. NASA grant guidance ensures effective and transparent stewardship of taxpayer dollars and compliance with applicable statutes, regulations, and policies.

NASA expends over $1.1 billion a year on grants and cooperative agreements that are funded by seven Mission Directorates and Offices. For more information on the types of grants and cooperative agreements that NASA supports, please refer to these [Grants Fact Sheets](https://www.nasa.gov/grants-policy-and-compliance-team/) .

GOM’s major responsibilities include:

* **Requirement Assessment and Operationalization** : GOM assesses statutory, regulatory, and policy requirements to determine how they can be operationalized within the Agency through NASA-specific guidance and processes.
* **Agency-wide Compliance Activities:** Assistance Listing maintenance and reporting, coordination of agency-wide OMB data calls, and coordination of the Federal Register notification process for agency-wide, grant-related requirements.
* **Agency-wide Audit Resolution** : Single audit monitoring and reporting; coordination of responses to Agency-wide, grant-related Government Accountability Office and Office of Inspector General audits; and audit recommendation closeout.
* **Internal and External Training** : Develop and deliver internal grants training to NASA personnel and external training for NASA grant applicants and recipients. The NASA grants community is encouraged to regularly check our [grants and cooperative playlist on NASA’s YouTube page](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLiuUQ9asub3RBxyZxDrKF57bIqxHGPtPh) , for new recorded trainings.
* **Consultation and Technical Assistance** : Provide internal and external consultation and technical assistance to stakeholders.

### Note

Please note that Grant Operations Management does not issue, administer, or manage grants and cooperative agreements. Rather, the NASA Shared Services Center (NSSC) is responsible for issuing and managing all grants and cooperative agreements for NASA. For information such as grant status reports, no cost extension requests and other forms, please visit the [NSSC’s website](https://www.nasa.gov/centers-and-facilities/grants-2/) .

[Learn More about](https://www.nasa.gov/centers/nssc)

Stennis Space Center, Mississippi NASA Shared Services Center

[](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/gateway-full-configuration-hero-image-121123large.jpg)

## **NASA Implementation of Executive Orders**

This section of the website provides updates on NASA’s implementation of recent Executive Orders that impact the Agency’s Federal financial assistance applicants and recipients. This webpage will be updated often.

### **Memorandum for NASA Grantee Community**

* [Guidance Regarding OMB Memorandum M-25-14 and Recent Temporary Restraining Orders](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/m-25-14-temporary-restraining-order-memo-to-stakeholders.pdf?emrc=838b21)

### **Update on Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility (DEIA) Executive Orders – January 29, 2025**

On January 23, 2025, NASA’s Office of Procurement (OP) released a [memorandum](https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-global-contractor-and-grantee-community-memos/) for the NASA contractor and grant community regarding Executive Order “ [Initial Rescission of Harmful Executive Orders and Actions](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/01/initial-rescissions-of-harmful-executive-orders-and-actions/) ” and the Office of Personnel Management’s (OPM) memorandum “ [Initial Guidance Regarding DEIA Executive Orders](https://chcoc.gov/sites/default/files/OPM%20Memo%20re%20Initial%20Guidance%20Regarding%20DEIA%20Executive%20Orders%201%2021-2025%20FINAL.pdf) .”

Per OP’s memo, NASA grant and cooperative agreement recipients shall immediately cease and desist all DEIA activities required for their grant. This work may include but is not limited to: DEIA plan requirements, training, workshops, reporting, considerations for staffing, or any other direct or indirect grant activity related to DEIA. All grant recipients shall notify their cognizant Grant Officer if they identify requirements within their grants that are in violation of this guidance. Your Grant Officer’s contact information can be found on your NF 1687, Notice of Award for Grant and Cooperative Agreement (NOA).

Thank you for your work and partnership with NASA.

## Regulations, Guidance, & Forms

### Regulations

#### **Electronic Code of Federal Regulations**

* [Title 2 of the Code of Federal Regulations (CFR): Federal Financial Assistance](https://gcc02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ecfr.gov%2Fcurrent%2Ftitle-2&data=05%7C02%7Cerin.i.rothback%40nasa.gov%7C4314f7eb548d40a3fa7a08dd4d0cdd2f%7C7005d45845be48ae8140d43da96dd17b%7C0%7C0%7C638751439814467711%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Sq6%2FDSvALXm28WtobJNbfjROd%2Bw9RHgVOMtS5S0WdCY%3D&reserved=0)
* [14 CFR 1274: Cooperative Agreements with Commercial Firms](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/14-cfr-1274-full-text.pdf?emrc=2221d7) (Rescinded January 2021)
* [14 CFR 1275: Research Misconduct](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-14/chapter-V/part-1275)

### Guidance

#### **NASA Grant and Cooperative Agreement Manual (GCAM): NASA’s Grant Manual for Proposers and Recipients**

The NASA Grant and Cooperative Agreement Manual (GCAM) provides comprehensive guidance on the pre-award, award, post-award, and closeout phases of the grant management life cycle to NASA proposers, award-managing personnel, and recipients to implement government-wide and NASA-specific regulations for applying for and administering grants and cooperative agreements.

* [NASA Grant and Cooperative Agreement Manual – March 2025](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/gcam-mar-2025.pdf?emrc=982b64)

#### **NASA Grant and Cooperative Agreement Terms and Conditions** (GCAT)

In FY2025, NASA separated the Terms and Conditions from the GCAM to create a standalone document. This document outlines both the general and specific terms and conditions and applies to all awards issued under 2 CFR 1800 (NASA’s adoption of 2 CFR 200.)

* [NASA Grant and Cooperative Agreement Terms and Conditions – March 2025](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/gcat-mar-2025.pdf?emrc=4d0aa8)
* [NASA Grant and Cooperative Agreement Terms and Conditions – January 2026](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/nasa-gcat-january-2026.pdf?emrc=872eed)

#### **Research Terms and Conditions (For Research Awards Issued Prior to October 1, 2024)**

NASA implemented the Federal-wide research terms and conditions for all research and research-related grant and cooperative agreement awards issued under 2 CFR 1800 (NASA’s adoption of 2 CFR 200). The Research Terms and Conditions implement the requirements of the Uniform Guidance and includes three companion documents:

RTC Appendix A: Prior Approval Matrix, RTC Appendix B: Subaward Requirements, and RTC Appendix C: National Policy Requirements).

The Research Terms and Conditions and companion documents are accessible on the [NSF website](https://www.nsf.gov/awards/terms-conditions/research) .

#### **Grant Information Circulars (GIC)**

NASA may issue interim grant guidance by publishing GICs that supplement, clarify, augment, remove, or alter information in the GCAM or GCAT. When the GCAM and GCAT are updated, relevant GICs are incorporated into those documents, and the GICs are archived.

* Active GICs:
  
    + [25-01 – Grant Payment Justifications](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/gic-25-01-grant-payment-justifications.pdf?emrc=f60144)
    + [25-02 – Termination Appeal Guidance](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/gic-25-02-termination-appeal-guidance.pdf?emrc=a4523c)
    + [25-03 – Reporting System Changes and Requirements](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gic-25-03-reporting-system-changes-and-rqmts.pdf?emrc=9be7b1)
    + [26-01 – Updated Guidance: Termination and Payment Terms and Conditions](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/gic-26-01-termination-payment-003.pdf?emrc=244c40)
    + [26-02 – Research Security Training Requirements](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/gic-26-02-research-security-training-requirements.pdf?emrc=b6b363)
    + [26-03 – FY 2026 Earmark Guidance](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/gic-26-03-fy2026-earmark-guidance.pdf?emrc=aa6598)
    + [26-04 – Unmanned Aircraft System (UAS) Security Requirements](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/gic-26-04-uas-security-requirements.pdf?emrc=1b87aa)
* [GIC Archive](https://www.nasa.gov/reference/grant-information-circulars-gic-archive/)

#### **Grant Notices (GNs)**

NASA issues Grant Notices to provide important updates to the grants community.

* Active GNs:
  
    + [GN 25-02: OMB’s Rescission of M-25-13](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/gn-25-02-ombs-rescission-of-m-25-13.pdf?emrc=ded5fa)
    + [GN 26-01: ScieENcv](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/gn-26-01-sciencv.pdf?emrc=94009d)

#### **Grant Forms**
